clips.text_zh: 沙地東西輸油管俾人炸咗，即係佢哋唔再可以繞過霍爾木茲海峽。AI 估算維修要 6 至 12 個月。10% 全球產油喺佢哋度。今日油價反而 dump 咗，即係唔關我事，睇定啲先。
clips.text_en_b1: Saudi east-west pipeline got hit, which means they can no longer go around the Strait of Hormuz. This is the only pipeline from the Persian Gulf to the Red Sea and very important. AI repair estimate is 6 to 12 months. Saudi Arabia has 10 percent of global oil production. Ironically, oil dumped today despite the news.
clips.source_hint: /biz/ thread on Saudi pipeline damage and oil

signal.rationale: Oil supply shock lasting 6-12 months is bullish for gold as inflation hedge, even if WTI dumped on the day

clips.text_en_b2: Saudi Arabia's east-west pipeline was struck, effectively cutting off their ability to bypass the Strait of Hormuz. Since it remains the sole route linking the Persian Gulf to the Red Sea, the damage is significant. AI-based estimates suggest repairs could take anywhere from six to twelve months, and the kingdom still accounts for roughly ten percent of global oil supply. Ironically, prices dumped today despite the headlines, which suggests the market isn't buying the shock factor just yet.
clips.text_en_c1: The East-West pipeline running through Saudi territory has reportedly been struck, effectively eliminating their capacity to circumvent the Strait of Hormuz entirely. Whatever AI projections exist suggest remediation would require somewhere between six and twelve months, during which roughly ten percent of global crude supply remains exposed. What strikes me as peculiar, however, is that oil dumped sharply on the session despite the headlines, which suggests the market is either discounting the damage or anticipating swift repairs. I am not directly involved either way, though I would prefer to sit on my hands and observe how this plays out before committing capital.
clips.text_en_c2: The East-West pipeline in Saudi Arabia has apparently been struck, a development of considerable geopolitical consequence, since it represents the sole conduit by which crude can circumvent the Strait of Hormuz, a chokepoint long considered the Persian Gulf's most acute vulnerability. Repair projections, generated by an AI estimator whose methodology one ought to treat with circumspection, range from six to twelve months. Given that the kingdom accounts for roughly ten percent of global supply, one would have anticipated a pronounced price reaction; instead, futures dumped on the session, an irony that has not gone unnoticed by traders weighing hedged exposures against the headline.

clips.text_zh: Doge 三日後上太空，仲有嘢郁。你唔買都冇所謂啦，但呢個位入少少再 sell 都唔會變 SNL 2.0。係咪 hype 又返嚟我就唔知，睇下點。
clips.text_en_b1: Doge goes to space in 3 days and youre not buying. If this shit explodes it is still gonna move up, so why not ape a bit, then sell so it does not become SNL 2.0. Or maybe it will just start the hype again, who knows.

signal.rationale: Short-term momentum play on the space catalyst, plan to sell into the pump

clips.text_en_b2: DOGE is heading to space in three days and there's still movement on the chart. Even if the whole thing flops, there's likely enough upside to justify throwing a small position in and taking profit before it turns into another SNL disaster. Whether this genuinely reignites the hype cycle or simply fizzles out remains anyone's guess, although the timing certainly feels like a setup.
clips.text_en_c1: Doge is, by all accounts, being routed to space within roughly three days, and yet retail positioning remains conspicuously tepid. Even if the entire spectacle flops, there is every reason to expect some reflexive upside, which makes a modest allocation followed by a disciplined exit a fairly asymmetric proposition, provided one avoids holding into the inevitable SNL 2.0-style collapse. Whether this development genuinely reignites speculative enthusiasm across the board is anyone's guess, but the setup is, at minimum, interesting. I shall be watching the order flow closely over the weekend rather than committing prematurely.
clips.text_en_c2: Dogecoin is purportedly en route to suborbital publicity within the next seventy-two hours, and while the broader memecoin complex has lost considerable vigour since its halcyon days, there remains a respectable case for a measured position. Should the marketing stunt detonate favourably, the resulting momentum would, by any reasonable technical analysis, carry price appreciably higher before distribution becomes prudent, and should it fail, one is hardly wedded to an asymmetric loss profile if sizing is appropriately calibrated. The clear objective is to participate enough to capture upside while remaining sufficiently unloved that one's portfolio does not devolve into a repeat of the infamous SNL episode that devastated retail conviction. Whether this heralds a genuine revival of speculative fervour or merely another terminal rally remains, as ever, a matter of conviction rather than evidence.

clips.text_zh: 呢條友 2025 年 5 月 83kg 肥但冇 muscle，cut 到 2026 年 4 月 65kg skinnyfat，bar 都 push 唔到。之後 lean bulk 到而家 80kg，bench 3x8 60kg，squat 3x6 90kg，deadlift 3x8 120kg。我而家都係咁上下，睇到有啲共鳴。
clips.text_en_b1: In May 2025 I was 83kg fat with almost no muscle. I cut hard until mid April 2026 and hit 65kg skinnyfat, I could not even bench the 20kg bar. Then I lean bulked back to 80kg. Now I bench 3x8 at 60kg, squat 3x6 at 90kg, and deadlift 3x8 at 120kg. I look different now compared to my zero lifting 80kg back in 2025.
clips.source_hint: /fit/ thread on going from skinnyfat to a real bulk

signal.rationale: Lifestyle thread, not a trade setup

clips.text_en_b2: Back in May 2025 I weighed 83 kilograms, carrying plenty of fat but virtually no muscle underneath. I committed to a brutal cut and by mid-April 2026 I'd dropped to 65 kilograms, yet I'd become textbook skinnyfat and could barely press the empty bar. I then ran a lean bulk back up to 80 kilograms, and my current numbers are benching 60 kilograms for three sets of eight, squatting 90 kilograms for three sets of six, and deadlifting 120 kilograms for three sets of eight.
clips.text_en_c1: In May 2025, I tipped the scales at 83 kilograms, carrying considerable adipose tissue but essentially no developed musculature to speak of. I committed to a fairly aggressive cut, which dragged me down to 65 kilograms by mid-April 2026, at which point I had become textbook skinnyfat and could not even press an empty twenty-kilogram bar through a full range of motion. I subsequently embarked on a measured lean bulk that brought me back up to 80 kilograms, and my current working numbers stand at 3x8 bench at 60 kilograms, 3x6 squat at 90 kilograms, and 3x8 deadlift at 120 kilograms.
clips.text_en_c2: The trajectory described here merits careful examination, since it charts a transformation whose intermediate phase is frequently elided in conventional before-and-after narratives. In May 2025, the subject presented at eighty-three kilograms, adipose tissue predominant and contractile mass conspicuously absent; an aggressive, sustained caloric deficit was then imposed, culminating by mid-April of the following year in a state one might charitably describe as skinnyfat, a condition so attenuated that even an unweighted twenty-kilogram barbell proved insurmountable on the bench press. A measured lean bulk subsequently restored mass to eighty kilograms, with concomitant neuromuscular adaptation such that current working weights stand at sixty kilograms for three sets of eight on the bench, ninety kilograms for three sets of six on the squat, and a hundred and twenty kilograms for three sets of eight on the deadlift.

clips.text_zh: 有條友同佢雙胞胎兄弟食一樣嘢、計過卡路里完全一樣、屎都燒過一樣，點解一個肥一個瘦？我諗到可能係 NEAT 或者熱量吸收率，但佢哋講到咁 detail 我都唔知點答。
clips.text_en_b1: I have an identical twin brother. He is lean, I am fat. We measured how much we eat and the calorie count is identical. The dietary fat, protein, and carbs are also identical. We even collected our faeces and incinerated it and it had an identical calorie measurement. So what is causing me to be obese while my brother is lean?

signal.rationale: Lifestyle thread, not a trade setup

clips.text_en_b2: My identical twin brother is lean while I'm obese, despite the fact that we've meticulously tracked everything. We eat identical meals, we've verified the calorie counts down to the gram, and we've even burned our faecal matter in a calorimeter, which returned identical values. My best guesses involve differential NEAT or some variation in caloric absorption, but honestly, given how controlled their experiment appears to be, I'm running out of plausible explanations.
clips.text_en_c1: I share an identical genetic background with my monozygotic twin brother, which makes our divergent body compositions all the more perplexing. He remains lean and visibly athletic, whereas I have accumulated substantial adipose tissue despite our having consumed precisely the same meals and meticulously tracked identical caloric, macronutrient, and micronutrient intakes. In what can only be described as an extraordinarily thorough personal experiment, we even collected and incinerated our respective faecal matter, which yielded identical caloric readings. The most plausible explanations I can offer are divergent NEAT profiles, differing thermic effects, or subtle variations in absorptive efficiency, though their methodological rigour leaves me genuinely uncertain how to respond.
clips.text_en_c2: The metabolic puzzle posed by monozygotic twins consuming identical diets yet diverging so radically in adiposity has long preoccupied exercise physiologists, and this particular case study, conducted with the methodological rigour one associates with a determined amateur rather than a clinical laboratory, is no less confounding for its thoroughness. Dietary intake has been meticulously recorded, macronutrient partitioning verified to the gram, and, most remarkably, faecal matter has been collected, combusted, and calorimetrically assessed, yielding energy values so proximate between siblings as to render post-absorptive efficiency differentials a rather unsatisfying explanation. The hypotheses one might reasonably entertain involve differential thermic effect of activity, particularly the non-exercise component subsumed under the NEAT framework, or perhaps subtle variations in gut microbiota that modulate extraction efficiency.

clips.text_zh: /g/ 嗰邊有人話 AI model 已經 plateau，VC 收緊啲錢所以要整啲 self restraint 嘅大話頂住。我都覺得依家 GPT 出嚟冇以前咁震撼，但工程界都仲用緊。
clips.text_en_b1: So they are admitting AI models have plateaued and are coming up with some fake story about self restraint so they do not lose VC money. I am so tired of this kind of bullshit. The new releases just do not hit like they used to last year.
clips.source_hint: /g/ thread on AI scaling plateau narrative

signal.rationale: Tech commentary, not a trade setup

clips.text_en_b2: So they're openly admitting that model performance has plateaued while spinning some narrative about ethical self-restraint, presumably to keep VC money flowing into the sector. I've grown genuinely exhausted by this kind of corporate doublespeak, because the latest GPT releases simply don't land the way they did a year ago. That said, working engineers are still building real products on top of these tools every single day, so the picture isn't entirely bleak.
clips.text_en_c1: The denizens of /g/ are now openly conceding that model performance has plateaued, and the prevailing theory is that marketing departments have spun a rather elaborate narrative around self-imposed restraint to placate increasingly skittish venture capital allocators. While I am genuinely fatigued by this particular flavour of corporate theatre, I would temper the cynicism somewhat by noting that working engineers across multiple disciplines still rely on these systems daily. The latest releases simply lack the visceral impact that characterised the prior generation, and the gap between capability and hype has rarely felt wider.
clips.text_en_c2: There now circulates, emanating from the technology boards with their customary mix of prescience and exasperation, an admission that frontier model development has encountered diminishing returns, and that the consequent narrative necessity has become one of manufactured restraint rather than authentic alignment. The cynical interpretation, which I find increasingly difficult to dismiss, holds that venture capital allocators have grown markedly less tolerant of unbridled scaling expenditure, and that the rhetorical pivot toward self-imposed guardrails serves principally to sustain the fiction of progress while preserving the next funding round. The subjective user experience corroborates this thesis, insofar as recent iterations of flagship models elicit noticeably less astonishment than their predecessors did a mere twelve months ago.

clips.text_zh: 英國 /pol/ 兄弟 post 咗一堆 dystopia 新聞：超市換晒平價 mackerel、14 歲細路喺 KFC 被斬、反移民示威者要自己揸船去攔截。睇完好似睇緊緊嘅未來，香港其實都差不多啦。
clips.text_en_b1: Brit pol thread full of dystopian bollocks. Skimpflation warning as tinned mackerel alternative hits more supermarket shelves. A boy aged 14 was among three teenagers stabbed in a KFC machete gang fight. Anti-immigration protesters will use their own boat to intercept migrants crossing the Channel today.

signal.rationale: News roundup, not a trade setup

clips.text_en_b2: The British /pol/ board has been flooded with genuinely dystopian headlines lately. Supermarkets are quietly substituting tinned mackerel as skimpflation spreads across more shelves, a fourteen-year-old boy was among three teenagers stabbed during a KFC machete brawl, and anti-immigration protesters have announced plans to take their own boat out to intercept migrants crossing the Channel. Reading through all of it feels like glancing at a grim preview, because Hong Kong isn't actually that far behind.
clips.text_en_c1: The British /pol/ contingent has curated what can only be described as a rather comprehensive dump of dystopian bulletin material, ranging from supermarkets quietly substituting tinned mackerel as cost pressures mount, to a fourteen-year-old boy who was reportedly among three teenagers slashed in a KFC machete brawl, to anti-immigration protesters announcing intentions to deploy their own vessels in an attempt to intercept migrants traversing the Channel. Taken collectively, the thread reads less like commentary and more like field reporting from a slow-motion decline. Hong Kong, for its part, appears to be charting a remarkably convergent trajectory, which hardly inspires confidence.
clips.text_en_c2: The British contingent of the politics boards has, with characteristic restraint, assembled a corpus of dispatches whose cumulative effect is less news bulletin than sociological case study in civilisational fatigue. Supermarket shelves are reportedly being colonised by tinned mackerel as premium protein becomes economically untenable for the median consumer, a phenomenon the cognoscenti have already dubbed skimpflation and which economists will doubtless mine for doctoral dissertations. Meanwhile, a fourteen-year-old was numbered among three adolescents requiring hospitalisation following a machete altercation at an outlet of a fast-food chain whose brand identity was, one suspects, the least compromised party in the proceedings. Concurrently, anti-immigration demonstrators, deprived of state maritime interdiction, have resorted to private vessels in an effort to intercept Channel crossings, a development whose legality remains, charitably, ambiguous.

clips.text_zh: 《BanG Dream!》MyGo 同 Ave Mujica 出新一集，仲有後日 Sunday live 講下季資訊。我幾個月前先睇完 MyGo，個結局真係頂唔順，Ave Mujica 反而比較正常。
clips.text_en_b1: BanG Dream MyGo Ave Mujica new episode is dropping soon, and there is a Sunday livestream with info about the next season. MyGo wrecked me last time I finished it, but Ave Mujica feels more grounded. Anyway, weekend is saved for /a/.
clips.source_hint: /a/ BanG Dream MyGo Ave Mujica thread

signal.rationale: Anime release thread, not a trade setup

clips.text_en_b2: A new episode of BanG Dream's MyGo and Ave Mujica is dropping this weekend, alongside a Sunday livestream that should reveal details about the next season. I only finished MyGo a few months back and the ending absolutely wrecked me emotionally, whereas Ave Mujica comes across as far more grounded by comparison. Either way, the weekend is effectively saved for anyone still hanging around /a/.
clips.text_en_c1: The BanG Dream! franchise is delivering a fresh episode featuring both MyGo and Ave Mujica imminently, complemented by a Sunday livestream at which additional information regarding the forthcoming season is expected to surface. I finally finished MyGo only a handful of months ago, and the finale left me in a state of genuine emotional disarray that I have struggled to fully process since, whereas Ave Mujica, despite its darker thematic leanings, projects a notably more grounded sensibility that I find considerably easier to metabolise. The weekend's viewing schedule has consequently been settled, much to the relief of /a/'s collectively fragile constitution.
clips.text_en_c2: The BanG Dream! franchise has elected this week to disburse fresh instalments of both MyGo!!!!! and Ave Mujica, a dual offering whose timing suggests the production committee harbours reasonable confidence in sustained engagement, particularly given that a Sunday livestream has been scheduled to disseminate intelligence regarding the subsequent season's trajectory. My personal acquaintance with MyGo is, I must confess, rather more recent than the dedicated viewer might assume, having completed the preceding arc only a handful of months ago; the denouement was, in technical parlance, emotionally devastating, a feat of narrative construction that one does not readily forgive. Ave Mujica, by contrast, projects a more grounded sensibility, its tonal palette less inclined toward operatic extremity.
